# Operator Packet — AI Usage Widget → Codex Left Sidebar

Operator = Claude (read-only). Validator/Integrator = Codex.
Scope: `MainWindow.xaml` + `MainWindow.xaml.cs` only. No other repo files touched.

## Context

Widget today is a 340×208 floating card pinned to the **bottom-right** of the Codex
window (`PositionWithinCodexWindow`, MainWindow.xaml.cs:329). User wants it relocated to
the **left sidebar, below the Chats list**, sized to the sidebar's exact width, with
fonts reduced to fit the narrower column.

Key constraint discovered: `CodexWindowState` (consumed at MainWindow.xaml.cs:251 / 329)
exposes only `WindowRect` and `WorkArea` — there is **no sidebar-width signal**. So
"exactly sidebar width" must be a single hardcoded constant the user tunes. I default it
to **260** and isolate it as one named const.

## Proposed XAML changes (MainWindow.xaml)

### 1. Window size (lines 5–6)
```xml
Width="260"      <!-- was 340; must equal the sidebar width constant in code -->
Height="150"     <!-- was 208 -->
```

### 2. Row heights (lines 22–24) — tighten 54 → 36
```xml
<RowDefinition Height="36" />
<RowDefinition Height="36" />
<RowDefinition Height="36" />
```

### 3. Border padding / row margins (optional tighten)
- Outer Border `Padding="12,10"` (line 18) → `Padding="10,8"`
- Row gap `Margin="0,0,0,8"` (lines 27, 51) → `Margin="0,0,0,6"`

### 4. Font reductions
| Element | Line | FontSize old → new |
|---|---|---|
| `Operator:` label | 35 | 26 → 13 |
| `OperatorText` | 42 | 28 → 16 |
| `Claude` label | 59 | 28 → 16 |
| `ClaudeText` badge | 73 | 28 → 16 |
| `Codex` label | 91 | 28 → 16 |
| `CodexText` badge | 105 | 28 → 16 |

### 5. Badge sizing (fit narrow column)
- `ClaudePercentBadge` MinWidth (line 67): 104 → 60; Padding (line 66) `12,2` → `8,1`
- `CodexPercentBadge` MinWidth (line 98): 104 → 60; Padding (line 97) `12,2` → `8,1`

## Proposed placement change (MainWindow.xaml.cs)

### Add a tunable constant near the other consts (~line 355)
```csharp
private const double CodexSidebarWidth = 260d;   // MUST match Window Width in XAML
private const double SidebarBottomInset = 16d;   // gap above sidebar bottom edge
```

### Replace body of `PositionWithinCodexWindow` (lines 339–343)
Old (bottom-right):
```csharp
var targetLeft = rightBottom.X - Width - 40;
var targetTop = rightBottom.Y - Height - 24;
Left = Math.Max(leftTop.X + 16, targetLeft);
Top  = Math.Max(leftTop.Y + 88, targetTop);
```
New (bottom-left, sidebar-aligned — "below Chats"):
```csharp
Width = CodexSidebarWidth;                 // enforce exact sidebar width at runtime
Left  = leftTop.X;                         // flush to sidebar left edge
Top   = Math.Max(leftTop.Y + 88,           // never above the Chats header band
                 rightBottom.Y - Height - SidebarBottomInset);
```
Rationale: anchoring to the sidebar bottom puts the card directly under the chats list
without needing to know the list length; `Left = leftTop.X` aligns it to the sidebar's
left edge; setting `Width` at runtime guarantees XAML/const can't drift apart visually.

## Verification commands

```powershell
# Build
dotnet build C:\Users\DoPra\Tools\AIUsageTray\src\T66.AIUsageTray\T66.AIUsageTray.csproj -c Debug

# Run and visually confirm placement against a live Codex window
dotnet run --project C:\Users\DoPra\Tools\AIUsageTray\src\T66.AIUsageTray\T66.AIUsageTray.csproj
```
Manual checks: widget sits flush to the Codex sidebar's left edge, width matches the
sidebar exactly, bottom of card ~16px above window bottom, all three rows + badges
render without clipping at the smaller fonts.

## Risks / caveats

- **Sidebar width is a guess (260).** If the real sidebar differs, edit the single
  `CodexSidebarWidth` const + XAML `Width` (keep them equal). This is the one value to
  confirm before sign-off.
- **DPI / per-monitor scaling:** `Left = leftTop.X` uses the device-transformed window
  left, consistent with existing logic — should track DPI correctly, but verify on the
  actual monitor scaling.
- **Short chats list:** bottom anchor may leave a gap between the chats list and the card
  on tall windows; acceptable per "below Chats." If a fixed offset under the header is
  preferred instead, swap the `Top` line for `leftTop.Y + <headerOffset>`.
- **Sidebar collapse:** if Codex's sidebar can collapse/resize, the fixed width won't
  follow it (no signal available in `CodexWindowState`).
- **Font floor:** 16px badges with `--%`/`100%` fit ~60px MinWidth; going below the
  proposed sizes risks ellipsis trimming on `OperatorText` (TextTrimming is on, line 47).
